root_cause.description: The v0.4 wrapper dynamically generated a live helper with an unquoted heredoc. Helper-local variables such as $rc and $tmp were expanded by the parent wrapper during helper creation. Because the parent wrapper used set -u and those variables were not defined in the parent scope, execution aborted after the smoke gate and before systemd-run/launch-marker creation.

architectural_correction: use a versioned immutable helper script with exact SHA256
copy helper as root:botmarket mode 0550 and verify it is readable/executable but not writable by botmarket
pass runtime paths through explicit systemd environment variables
capture Python and tee pipeline exit codes inside the helper using PIPESTATUS
use recovery-specific log/exit/marker names to avoid collision with the failed v0.4 attempt
validate and republish the prior PASS smoke before replacing it with a fresh smoke
publish structured progress metadata from --status into GitHub runtime inbox

recovery_iteration.consumption_rule: Count only when the materially changed v0.4.1 implementation is actually re-executed after this technical failure.
